text: Zither HarpHello, boys and girls, I am Miss Tan.Nice to meet you.Today, we will learn module 4, unit 3, story time.Dear children, I like stories very much.Do you like stories?Look, here are some story books.在这些故事中,都有一个大坏蛋。他是谁呢?Ah, it's the wolf.Oh, Eddie and his friends act out a story together.There is a wolf in the story too.Eddie和他的小伙伴们在表演什么故事呢?Let's watch.I'm the wolf.I'm the boy.I'm the farmer.A boy and a wolf.A wolf!Help!Here come the farmers.Where's the wolf?Ha ha!No wolf!You are a bad boy.Here comes the wolf.Oh no!A poor boy.Don't tell a lie.The wolf runs away.Which story do they act out?Let's have a look.Oh, this story is about a boy and a wolf.Listen carefully.Let's read the title.The children act as different roles in the story.Who will be the boy?Listen again.Who will be the wolf?What about other children?Listen.Oh, Danny will be the farmer.FarmerFarmerCould you be Danny?Danny says I'm the farmer.Kitty will be the farmer too.What does she say?Kitty says I'm the farmer.What about Alice?I'm the narrator.Oh, Alice will be the narrator.她是故事的旁白,是解说故事的人。NarratorNarratorCould you be Alice?She says I'm the narrator.The children start to act.在故事中,小男孩总是爱搞恶作剧。He always cries the wolf.What does he say?What does the boy say?Can you try?The boy is crying a wolf.Is there a wolf?Let's watch again.Where is the wolf?Ha ha, no wolves.No wolves, but the boy cries.A wolf, help, help.Oh, the boy cries.A wolf, a wolf.And he cries for help.Help, help.Let's be the boy together.Who comes to help?Where is the wolf boy?The boy says.Oh, no wolves.No wolves.The boy laughs and says.Ha ha, let's be the boy together.Oh, the farmers are angry.Now let's be the naughty boy and read.Here we go.Nice reading.As we know, at the first time, the farmers come to help, but no wolves.The boy laughs.小男孩捉弄了農夫們。The boy cries the wolf again.This time, do the farmers come to help?Let's go on watching.Listen, here come the farmers.Oops, no wolves.But the boy still cries.Excellent.Could you be the boy?Oh, the boy says.Oh, he laughs again.Children, can you be the boy and read?Super.Let's read in rows.Children, you will be the boy and I will be the farmer.So, this time, no wolves.The boy plays tricks on the farmers again.He laughs.Finally, does the wolf really come?Oh, the wolf is coming.Oh, the boy is really afraid.Can you be the boy?Great.The boy cries and cries.Do the farmers come?Oh, look.Maybe he says.Who can help?What else?Think it over.Actually, the boy says.How poor the boy is.Now, let's be the boy and try to act out this part.Good try.So this time the wolf really comes.小男孩叫了很久,农夫还没有出现。The boy is really afraid.So children you see, the boy cries the wolf again and again.The farmers come to help, but no wolves.When the wolf really comes, the farmers don't believe the boy anymore.小朋友们,你能读出小男孩从得意到害怕的语气吗?You are the boy now.Let's read the story again.You are the boy.You are the wolf.小朋友们,小男孩叫了这么久,农夫还没有出现。最后他们到底会不会赶来呢?让我们下节课再揭晓。That's all for today.Dear children, you did good jobs.See you next time!Thank you for watching!
